description: Plausible Events API posts to plausible.io/api/event. Self-hosted endpoints on other hosts are not contracted.

params.name: name
params.description: It is the event name. `pageview` is the special page-view event; any other value is a custom event. The tracker also sends this as `n`.
params.fix_hint: Set `name` to `pageview` or to a custom event name.

params.name: n
params.description: Short key for `name`, used by the JavaScript tracker.
params.fix_hint: Set `n` or `name` to the event name.

params.name: url
params.description: Plausible accepts absolute, app and relative URLs. Data URIs are unsupported.
params.fix_hint: Send the page URL or relative page path.

params.name: u
params.description: Plausible accepts absolute, app and relative URLs. Data URIs are unsupported.
params.fix_hint: Send the page URL or relative page path.

params.name: domain
params.description: It is the site domain as configured in the Plausible account. The tracker also sends this as `d`.
params.fix_hint: Set `domain` to the domain you added in Plausible, such as `example.com`.

params.name: d
params.description: Short key for `domain`, used by the JavaScript tracker.
params.fix_hint: Set `d` or `domain` to the Plausible site domain.

params.name: referrer
params.description: It is the referrer for this event. Plausible documents it as optional; the tracker sends `document.referrer`.
params.fix_hint: Send the referring URL or host in `referrer`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: revenue.currency
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of `revenue.amount`. Plausible discards revenue data when the currency is invalid, and still records the event.
params.fix_hint: Send a three-letter currency code in `revenue.currency`, such as `USD`.

params.name: revenue.amount
params.description: It is the revenue amount. Plausible documents a float or numeric string, and discards revenue data when the amount is invalid.
params.fix_hint: Send `revenue.amount` as a number or numeric string, such as `1322.22`, without a currency symbol.

params.name: interactive
params.description: It says whether the event counts for bounce detection. Plausible documents a boolean; omit it, or send `false` for a non-interactive custom event.

params.name: props
params.description: Plausible retains at most 30 custom property entries and discards additional entries.

params.name: revenue
params.description: The vendor documents `revenue` in the request contract.
The vendor documents `` in the request contract.

params.name: props.*
params.description: Custom properties accept scalar values. Arrays and objects are discarded; null is displayed as (none).

params.name: overlong_property_name
params.description: Custom property names are limited to 300 characters.

rules.message: The event has neither `name` nor `n`. Plausible documents `name` as required.
rules.fix_hint: Set `name` (or `n`) to `pageview` or to a custom event name.

rules.message: The event has neither `url` nor `u`. Plausible documents `url` as required.
rules.fix_hint: Set `url` (or `u`) to an absolute page URL.

rules.message: The event has neither `domain` nor `d`. Plausible documents `domain` as required.
rules.fix_hint: Set `domain` (or `d`) to the site domain configured in Plausible.

rules.message: `url` uses the data URI scheme. Plausible documents that data URLs are not supported by the Events API.
rules.fix_hint: Send an `http`, `https`, or app URL such as `https://example.com/page` or `app://localhost/login`.

rules.message: The event sends `revenue.amount` without `revenue.currency`. Plausible documents both on the revenue object.
rules.fix_hint: Add `revenue.currency` as an ISO 4217 code, such as `USD`.

rules.message: The event sends `revenue.currency` without `revenue.amount`. Plausible documents both on the revenue object.
rules.fix_hint: Add `revenue.amount` as a number or numeric string, such as `1322.22`.

rules.message: The page URL path exceeds Plausible's published 2000-character limit.
The page URL path exceeds Plausible's published 2000-character limit.

params.name: method
params.description: This published ingestion operation uses HTTP POST.

params.name: content_type
params.description: Use a published request media type.

params.name: body
params.description: The request body is a JSON object.

params.name: headers.user-agent
params.description: Plausible requires the original visitor User-Agent.

params.name: headers.x-forwarded-for
params.description: Optional IP chain. Plausible uses the first valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
